resources.string: The USB edition update channel is not published yet.
Recording on this phone · USB connection required
USB hardware support is in preparation. Real measurements must be verified with the FT232H board. Optical response and absolute calibration remain unvalidated.
Connect the FT232H and both sensors using a USB OTG data adapter.
The app samples both sensors and processes their readings on the phone.
Discard the lowest and highest sample
Disconnecting USB or closing the app interrupts recording. Reconnecting never restarts a session automatically.
USB-only edition: FT232H + AS7331 + AS7343. The phone owns processing, time, alerts and storage. ESP32 support is preserved in the legacy-esp32 branch.
Stop recording before changing the data source.
Legacy sensor settings remain archived. They are not applied automatically to the USB hardware.
